KNSL.name: Kinsale Capital
KNSL.selection_reason: Track A: gates passed (quality, valuation, dislocation, moat) · conviction 77 · -22% from 52wH, RSI 54.6 · decline read: Sentiment disconnect

This is the Buffett entry template: boring business, down for sentiment reasons, best-in-class economics compounding at 15%+ for a decade, high FCF, zero AI disruption risk.

KNSL.invalidation: Combined ratio rises above 85% for two consecutive quarters. Premium growth falls below 0% YoY.

CLS.name: Celestica
CLS.selection_reason: Track B window: conviction 74 (tier B) · RSI 40.9 inside entry window · -38.7% from 52wH
